mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 74 degree temperatures with overcast skies near Harriet Park and a Waxing Gibbous moon phase.

The City of Verona has closed entries for the I Voted sticker contest. Verona students in grades K through 12 submitted their designs, and now the community will have the chance to vote on the winners from July 28 through August 7.

We have plenty to look forward to, with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.
In a noteworthy call from the past week, officers responded on July 13 to a situation where a driver was arrested for O-W-I after their vehicle became trapped on a large rock.
Today is the perfect day to stop by Culver's for the Chocolate Volcano flavor of the day; they are open until 10:30 PM tonight.
